We owe you an explanation.
September 20
: An important update for readers
in the United States
.
You deserve an explanation, so please don't skip this 1-minute read. It's
Sunday
,
September 20
, and you only had a small chance of seeing our message. This year, Wikipedia has seen fewer visitors and fewer new supporters, so your visit today means a lot. If you're like us, you've used Wikipedia countless times to settle an argument or to satisfy a curiosity. Whether it's 3 in the morning or afternoon, Wikipedia is useful. Please give
$2.75
.
It's been 25 years and Wikipedia is still free. It's still created by people, not machines. We don't run ads or put up paywalls to make a profit off of your attention. Wikipedia's here to satisfy your curiosity and give you the facts you need.
Less than 2% of our readers donate, so if you've never given and Wikipedia has provided you with at least
$2.75
worth of knowledge, donate today. If you are undecided, remember any contribution helps.
Proud host of Wikipedia and other free knowledge projects

and
Worker
